slot.brief: Describe a small family with siblings and cousins; ask how many males/females or how many members of a particular relation exist.

stem: Meera and Nisha are sisters. Meera has one son and one daughter; Nisha has two daughters and one son. How many female first cousins does Meera’s son have?

verdicts.working: Meera’s son’s first cousins are Nisha’s children. Nisha has two daughters, so he has 2 female first cousins.

working:
Meera’s son’s first cousins are Nisha’s children. Nisha has two daughters, so he has 2 female first cousins. Meera’s daughter is his sister, not his cousin.
